sn22.70:1.2: Atha- || || 3 Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn22.70:1.3: Sādhu bhante Bhagavā saṅkhittena dhammaṃ desetu yaṃ ahaṃ Bhagavato dhammaṃ sutvā || pa || vihareyyan ti || || 4
sn22.70:1.4: Yaṃ kho bhikkhu rajanīyasaṇṭhitaṃ || tatra te chando pahātabbo ti || ||
sn22.70:2.1: Yathā katham pana tvam bhikkhu mayā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa vitthārena attham ājānāsīti || || 6
sn22.70:2.2: Rūpaṃ kho bhante rajanīyasaṇṭhitam || tatra me chando pahātabbo || ||
sn22.70:2.6: Viññāṇaṃ rajanīyasaṇṭhitaṃ || tatra me chando pahātabbo || ||
sn22.70:2.7: Imassa khvāham bhante Bhagavatā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa evaṃ vitthārena atthaṃ ājānāmī ti || || 7
sn22.70:3.2: sādhu kho tvam bhikkhu mayā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa vitthārena attham ājānāsi || ||
sn22.70:3.3: Rūpaṃ kho bhikkhu rajanīyasaṇṭhitaṃ || tatra te chando pahātabbo || ||
sn22.70:3.7: Viññāṇam rajanīyasaṇṭhitam || tatra te chando pahātabbo || ||
sn22.70:3.8: Imassa kho bhikkhave mayā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa evaṃ vitthārena attho daṭṭhabbo ti || || 8-9 Atha || || la || ||
sn22.70:3.9: Aññataro ca so bhikkhu arahatam ahosīti || || 1
